visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A small girl with pigtails in a green dress watches a TV screen showing the character Elsa from Frozen. An elderly man in a dark jacket sits in a wooden chair nearby in a wood-furnished living room. (2) Close-up shots of hands holding a blue fabric package, then inspecting a low-quality blue sequined dress on a dark desk. (3) Exterior view of a building with a large red sign reading '永樂布業商場' under a clear blue sky. (4) Hands use silver scissors to cut through layers of blue and white tulle. A sewing machine needle rapidly stitches fabric. A blue bodice with sequins is assembled on a small white dress mannequin. (5) Hands hand-sew intricate silver and bead decorations onto the blue bodice. The completed dress, featuring a white tulle skirt and blue sequined top, is displayed on a mannequin while digital snow particles fall. (6) The girl, now wearing the custom-made Elsa dress, runs and twirls happily on an outdoor sidewalk lined with red brick walls and trees. She smiles widely, looking at the camera. (7) An adult hand holds the child's small hand as she walks away. (8) The girl sits on the floor in front of a full-length mirror in a brightly lit studio, looking at her reflection and back at the camera.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 little girl (main character), 1 elderly man in background, 1 mother (visible through hands and silhouette).
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young toddler girl with dark hair tied in pigtails, initially in a green dress, later in a custom blue and white tulle Elsa princess dress.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A home interior with wooden shelves and a TV; a fabric market exterior; a sewing workspace with a mannequin; and an urban sidewalk with a red fence.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly female voice narrates over a gentle bed of orchestral strings and piano. The acoustic atmosphere is clean with minimal background room tone. (2) As the narrator describes a disappointing purchase, the music maintains its steady tempo. A very slight rustle of plastic packaging can be heard under the voice. (3) The narration becomes faster-paced during a montage, accompanied by high-pitched mechanical whirring sounds from a sewing machine and swift 'whoosh' transition effects. (4) The narration stops as the background music swells into a triumphant, Disney-style orchestral theme featuring bright violins and glockenspiel chimes. A subtle 'ding' sound effect highlights the finished dress. (5) The female voice returns with a warm, lower-pitched emotional tone over the continuing triumphant music, concluding with a soft request to follow the channel.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Conflict -> Action -> Resolution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a mother's cosplay craftsmanship and parental devotion by creating a high-quality Elsa princess dress for her daughter after a disappointing online shopping experience. The video highlights the contrast between mass-produced and hand-made items.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video is a personal storytelling vlog centered on a parent-child relationship and DIY skill.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses triumphant, high-production-value music to transform a DIY sewing project into a heroic narrative of maternal love. The inclusion of the Yongle Fabric Market location grounds the story in a specific cultural context.
